data.gender_notes: Tvesa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tvesa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tushta', which means 'content' or 'satisfied'. In Hindu mythology, Tvesa is the goddess of abundance and prosperity. She is often depicted as holding a lotus in her hand, symbolizing wealth and purity. The name Tvesa carries the meaning “Abundance, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tvesa usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Tvesa signifies contentment and satisfaction with one's current state of being. It is believed that those named Tvesa will possess a strong sense of inner peace and happiness, even in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Tvesa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tvesa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
